alerts.headerText: Shuttle Busing Between 33rd Street Station to the Malvern Loop
alerts.descriptionText: Bus service replaces trolley service from 33rd Street Station to the Malvern Loop, on Saturday, November 7 and Sunday, November 8.

alerts.headerText: Weekly Sunday & Monday Trolley Tunnel Diversion
alerts.descriptionText: Service is re-routed to 40th St and Market St on Sunday and Monday nights beginning at 10 pm until 5 am the next morning due to scheduled maintenance. Use the [L] Market-Frankford Line for continued service to/from Center City.

alerts.headerText: Shuttle Busing Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St Stations
alerts.descriptionText: Bus service replaces trains from Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St stations on November 7-8 and November 14-15. Riders should allow an additional 10-15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit septa.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate  Manayunk/Norristown Shuttle Bus schedule page.

alerts.headerText: Outbound Platform Boarding, Train #207, Norristown Transit Center
alerts.descriptionText: Every weekday until further notice, passengers must board inbound Train #207 departing at 5:50 am on the outbound platform at Norristown Transit Center.
